programme.title: Na gauči s Menzelem
programme.desc: Vládni, Británie: nejlepší Angličané ve Fast Lapu Na gauči s Menzelem – zábavný automobilový pořad s moderátorem pořadu Fast Lap a bývalým závodním jezdcem Christianem Menzelem! Christian zde představuje svou osobní top pětku k nejrůznějším automobilovým tématům – od nejrychlejšího zajetého okruhu přes cenově dostupnou zábavu za volantem až po své oblíbené veterány. Menzel sdílí s diváky své bohaté odborné znalosti, napínavé anekdoty, to vše s pořádnou dávkou humoru a vášní pro vše, co má čtyři kola., (šport)

programme.title: Srovnávací testy
programme.desc: Mercedes-AMG C43 T-Modell Redaktoři Auto moto und sport testují nové modely: Zrychlení, brzdy, ale i slalom nebo praktičnost. Testy odhalují jejich klady i zápory., (zábava)

programme.title: Drag Race
programme.desc: Porsche: výkon ze Stuttgartu Za jak dlouho zrychlují sportovní automobily do 100? A za jak dlouho do 200? Kolik času jim zabere ujet půl míle? Tohle a ještě spoustu dalšího prověříme na závodech drugsterů na letišti Mendigu., (šport)

programme.title: Přednost v jízdě
programme.desc: Lamborghini Temerario První pohled na premiéry modelů ihned po jejich uvedení na trh. Přednost před ostatními ve zprávách a prvních dojmech z nových modelů - kompetentně a kriticky., (zábava)

programme.title: Bloch vysvětluje
programme.desc: Těžké auto = vysoká spotřeba? Tři největší omyly o spotřebě! Jaký je rozdíl mezi turbem a atmosférickým motorem? Jak ideálně zrychlovat? Jaké jsou nejčastější mýty o tom, jak šetřit palivo? Automobilový svět je plný otázek a Alexander Bloch na ně odpoví. V pořadu „Bloch vysvětluje“ se dozvíte vše, vystudovaný inženýr a motoristický novinář podává vše jasnou, pochopitelnou a zábavnou formou., (zábava)

programme.title: Bloch vysvětluje
programme.desc: Je třeba se vyvarovat těchto chyb! 13 omylů o pneumatikách. Jaký je rozdíl mezi turbem a atmosférickým motorem? Jak ideálně zrychlovat? Jaké jsou nejčastější mýty o tom, jak šetřit palivo? Automobilový svět je plný otázek a Alexander Bloch na ně odpoví. V pořadu „Bloch vysvětluje“ se dozvíte vše, vystudovaný inženýr a motoristický novinář podává vše jasnou, pochopitelnou a zábavnou formou., (zábava)

programme.title: Garáž 21
programme.desc: Epizoda 16 Garáž 21: aktuální, informativní a zábavné – od malých aut přes elektromobily až po superauta. Přehledový pořad především testuje, představuje vášnivé sběratele a za volantem sedí opravdový závodní profík. Kdo miluje čtyři kola, nenechá si ujít., (zábava)

programme.title: 100 mil
programme.desc: Kolín nad Rýnem "100 mil" vás zavede do nespočtu destinací po celém světě. Každý díl se soustředí na jeden region a jeho kulinářské a turistické zajímavosti. Divák se může těšit na objížďku s automobilem, který je pro danou zemi nebo region typický., (šport)

programme.title: Menzelovy výjezdy
programme.desc: BMW E24 628 CSi Christian Menzel se představuje v nové roli: V pořadu „Menzelovy výjezdy“ nejde o rychlé časy na okruhu, ale o nostalgické pocity s klasickými automobily. Háček je v tom, že Christian na začátku neví, jaký poklad bude zrovna řídit., (zábava)

programme.title: Reportáž
programme.desc: Reportáž Oldtimer-Tour BMW 502 Cabrio auto motor und sport – Reportáže, které vypráví nevšední příběhy ze života automobilů. Pokud jde o automobilovou vášeň, jsme vždy ve správný čas na správném místě., (dokument)

programme.title: Petrolheads
programme.desc: Alfa Romeo Giulietta TI: je mu víc jak 60, ale na okruhu se neztratí Petrolheads – to jsou vášniví sběratelé veteránů, kteří v každém dílu otevírají své garáže a sdílejí příběhy svých automobilových pokladů. Ponořte se do světa plného legendárních vozů, osobních vzpomínek a řemeslných mistrovských děl. To je povinností každého milovníka aut!, (zábava)

programme.desc: Jaguar F-Type Christian Menzel je závodník, instruktor a trenér. Je obeznámen s každou automobilovou koncepcí a ví, jak rychle řídit auto. V pořadu s názvem Menzel za volantem předvádí převážně sportovní auta a vysvětluje na výkonných bolidech, co je důležité při dynamické jízdě na závodním okruhu., (šport)

programme.title: Moove - mobilita budoucnosti
programme.desc: EActros Mobilita neznamená pouze přejezd z bodu A do bodu B. Zejména v městském prostředí je třeba hledat nové cesty pro zajištění udržitelné mobility a zahájení změn v dopravě. programme.desc: Epizoda 16 Garáž 21: aktuální, informativní a zábavné – od malých aut přes elektromobily až po superauta. Přehledový pořad především testuje, představuje vášnivé sběratele a za volantem sedí opravdový závodní profík. Kdo miluje čtyři kola, nenechá si ujít., (zábava)

programme.title: 100 mil
programme.desc: Kolín nad Rýnem "100 mil" vás zavede do nespočtu destinací po celém světě. Každý díl se soustředí na jeden region a jeho kulinářské a turistické zajímavosti. Divák se může těšit na objížďku s automobilem, který je pro danou zemi nebo region typický., (šport)

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show II
programme.desc: Kitten Grifters. Tom and Jerry have made a connection between a variety of different cases involving the mysterious disappearance of household items -- all including a sighting of a supernaturally cute kitten. Tom and Jerry are on the case! Their investigation reveals a litter of hardened kitten con artists who are using the items they've taken to form a makeshift home. These kitty criminals are just looking for a home, but they don't want to be separated!

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show II
programme.desc: School of Hard Knocks. Like a big brother, Jerry gets a sleepy Tuffy out of bed, makes them both breakfast, gets Tuffy cleaned up, puts on his backpack and scoots him past the mean ol' cat to the house next door where WINSTON waits, greeting his students, a gaggle of mice, including Jerry. They each hand their kindly teacher a treat as they take their seats on little spools of thread, ready for the start of class. Winston is teaching his students the basics of force and motion, and today they're going on a field trip to see physics in action. They end up at Tom's house where Tom bears the brunt of the school load until he gets a little tutoring himself.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show II
programme.desc: Cat-A-Tonic Mouse. When Jerry gets a cold he gets no help from Tom who chooses instead to use the mouse's down time to taunt the little guy and eat all of his favorite treats. Jerry resorts to help from Uncle Pecos who, after trying a few Texas remedies, mixes a home brewed Texas tonic to knock the cold p-p-p-plum out. As a side effect of the Tabasco fueled brew, the mouse is breathing fire within minutes. When Tom catches the same cold and gets a dose of the brew, it's an all-out flame war! Good thing Uncle Pecos is there to put the fire out!

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show II
programme.desc: Brain Food. Waffles is worried that his roommate Bo had his brain eaten by aliens, leaving him a zombie dog. Turns out he's not the first dog in his neighborhood to wake up stupid. Afraid of becoming the next Bo, Waffles hires the Cat and Mouse Detectives to put a stop to this alien invasion. Our Narrator thinks all of this extraterrestrial talk is a load of sci-fi hooey but not our detectives; they're covering all their bases and taking every necessary precaution. Turns out the dog's behavior has more to do with a tainted bag of kibble than visitors from another planet… or does it?

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show II
programme.desc: Wish Bone. Butch finds a wish bone in the garbage and dupes Tom into believing that it will make his wishes come true. Butch trades Tom the bone for a dozen cans of cat food. The alley cat thinks he's pulled off the best scam ever UNTIL Tom's wishes start coming true (from Jerry getting his just dessert to Toodles paying an unexpected visit)! Now Butch will stop at nothing to get that bone back!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings III
programme.desc: In a vast natural reserve lost in the middle of the untamed wilderness, there is a small haven of human civilization: the forest ranger's house. Because he is (from his point of view) the most evolved animal on earth, the bear Grizzy feels it's only natural that the ranger's house becomes his territory as soon as its owner is away. No other animal dares to contest this "bear's privilege" except the most inoffensive, stupid and ridiculous mammal family that exists: the Lemmings - who also move into the house as soon as the ranger is gone. Grizzy and the Lemmings lead a merciless battle over the house in an atmosphere of total madness, where the two adversaries constantly try to outdo each other with nasty tricks!

Unbeknown to the Ranchers, the raptors follow them back to the Dino HQ, and they must know protect the baby dino once again

programme.title: Dino Ranch: Island Explorers
programme.desc: Noodles Finds Some Friends. The volcano on Dino Island is ready to blow! The Ranchers' mission: rescue a cluster of dino eggs too close to the volcano's fiery base before the heat turns their nests into ash! The operation hits a snag when a frantic Plesiosaur needs help! Jon frees the panicked creature, and the two become fast friends! He names her Noodles, and she's eager to help, maybe a little too eager!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series IV
programme.desc: The Big Shrink. When Irma leaves Mr Bean in charge of her knitwear stall, he manages to tip all the jumpers into a muddy puddle. Panicking, he decides to take them all home to clean them in his washing machine. But somehow he ends up shrinking them all, so tries all sorts of ways to stretch them back to their original size before Irma finds out.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series IV
programme.desc: Winning Ticket. Mr Bean spots a cool remote-controlled car Mr Paliwal is selling at a yard sale, so he sets up a tombola with his own stuff as prizes to raise some cash. He’s raffling off some not very good things from his flat - the star prize however is his green car, so lots of people are buying tickets hoping to win the car. But Mr Bean has rigged the tombola so that the car can’t be won. Will he get away with it?

programme.title: Tom and Jerry Gokko
programme.desc: Fish Bowl / At the Cinema / Coffee Shop. Tom has Jerry and Tuffy trapped in a fish bowl. / Tom is at the movies, Jerry and Tuffy pop out of his bucket of popcorn. / At a coffee shop, Jerry and Tuffy are eating a strawberry cake.

programme.title: Baby Lemmings
programme.desc: Instant Sticking. The Baby Lemmings accidentally discover how to make syrup flow from the trunk of a maple tree. It's a strangely sticky substance that can be used to invent all kinds of games! Their neighbour, Baby Raccoon, who is a real stickler for cleanliness, thinks they should get rid of the stuff, which collects leaves and dust and sticks everywhere, otherwise the forest and its lair will never be spotless!

programme.title: Baby Lemmings
programme.desc: Join the party. Seeing a line of ants carrying leaves and flowers gives a group of baby lemmings the idea of doing a choreography to imitate them. Seeing that their baby lemming friends like it, they decide to put on a little show. Baby Lynx discovers this and, a little jealous, decides to crash the show and put herself forward. Clumsily, she unwittingly puts an end to the show. While the baby lemmings are looking for a quiet place to do their show again, Baby Lynx decides to put on a show of her own to steal the show.

programme.title: Baby Lemmings
programme.desc: Log Racing. Baby lemmings discover a fun new game: running on logs! While playing, the Baby lemmings find themselves racing Baby Lynx without realizing it. To the horror of Baby Lynx, who hates defeat, she loses the race! The Baby Lemmings with their logs are faster than Baby Lynx. Her pride stung, she decides to steal the vehicle that allows her to be faster.

programme.title: Batwheels III
programme.desc: A Purr-fect Pair. When the rambunctious Kitty insists on joining Redbird on a covert mission to tail King Tut, Red worries things could get out of hand.

programme.title: Batwheels II
programme.desc: Batwheels, a preschool animated action-adventure comedy series starring the most heroic and iconic vehicles from the DC universe. They are a team of incredible crimefighters who have banded together to oppose evil, combat crime and clean up the streets of Gotham City. They are...okay, they're NOT Batman and Robin. They're the Batwheels - an awesome group of sentient super-powered crime-fighting vehicles defending Gotham City alongside Batman, Robin, Batgirl and a host of DC Super Heroes. Having just been created by the Batcomputer, our heroes are essentially kids with little to no life experience. Led by Bam (The Batmobile), the Batwheels - Bibi (The Batgirl Cycle), Red (The Redbird), Jett (The Batwing) and Buff (The Bat Truck) - must navigate the growing pains of being a newly formed super team as well as the growing pains that come with just being a kid.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series II
programme.desc: Home Movie. Mr Bean is unimpressed with a horror movie he sees at the cinema and reckons he can do much better. Bean sets out to create his very own home movie masterpiece –featuring Mrs Wicket Irma and Teddy! The screening in the garden is a huge success but will Mrs Wicket be pleased with her makeover and starring role?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series II
programme.desc: Fish Sitting. Mr Bean has to look after Mrs Wicket’s pet goldfish while she is away. With a ravenous Scrapper sniffing around Bean ends up becoming more bodyguard than babysitter. But when he manages to lose his fishy friend Mr Bean takes a nightmare journey down the sewer and back to his neighbour’s house via the park. Can Mr Bean get the pesky pet back in the bowl before Mrs Wicket returns home?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series IV
programme.desc: Grounded. Mr Bean is watching Clint Chiseljaw - his favourite action TV show - with Billy, but Mrs Wicket orders her nephew downstairs to finish his chores. Inspired by Clint’s catchphrase – “Nobody gets left behind”, Mr Bean tries a variety of different daring plans to break Billy out of Mrs Wicket’s flat. But none of them work, until he hits on the perfect plan… or so he thinks!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series
programme.desc: The Big TV. Irma Gobb comes round to watch TV and Bean finds that liking different programmes to your girlfriend can be very bad for a relationship. After an explosive argument the TV blows up, forcing Mr. Bean to invent his own very ingenious form of home entertainment.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series IV
programme.desc: Un-Suitable. Mr Bean peers through the window of the opening party of an art exhibition and sees free snacks being handed around – yum! But he’s told by the bouncer that he needs to be smartly dressed. So he sneaks into the artist’s studio and paints a tuxedo onto himself. This time he’s let in, but will Bean’s fake painted suit last long enough for him to get his free food?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series IV
programme.desc: Fitness Instructor. Mr Bean is trying to watch the motor racing on TV, when Mrs Wicket interrupts him to offer a deal – revamp her garden with new paving and ornaments, and he’ll get a month’s rent for free. Bean reluctantly agrees, but when he sees Mr Paliwal finish a personal training session and keen for more, he offers him a new workout… doing all Mr Bean’s work for him while he watches the racing! Win, win!

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! II
programme.desc: There Wolf. The gang rushes Scooby to an animal hospital when he suddenly falls ill. But things go from bad to worse when they discover the Gothic, old hospital is also home to a rampaging werewolf!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series III
programme.desc: Mr Bean returns for a third series of his animated adventures. Featuring in 26 brand new episodes. This series follows Mr Bean, his best friend Teddy and his long-suffering landlady Mrs Wicket as we witness more of the mishaps that surround Mr Bean's daily life. Mr Bean becomes obsessed with computer gaming, prevents Mrs. Wicket from selling her house, builds his own caravan, rescues a football from a haunted house and finds himself in many other hilarious escapades. All voiced by Rowan Atkinson.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series IV
programme.desc: Table Tennis Trick. Mr Bean sees Mr Paliwal practising for a local table tennis tournament and decides he wants to enter to try to win the cash prize. He goes home, adapts his dining table into a table tennis table, and designs an ingenious ball-firing machine using a foot pump and vacuum hose. None of this helps much, and Mr Bean worries he’s not improving – but could this new device be adapted and answer his problems?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series
programme.desc: Roadworks. Mr. Bean’s tranquillity is shattered by deafening roadworks outside his bedroom window. Threats, sabotage and subterfuge all fail to quell the cacophony until Bean has the ingenious idea of feeding the workmen into peaceful submission. But the silence ends with a bang!

programme.title: Tom and Jerry Gokko
programme.desc: Party Time! Jerry sneaks into the party set up to steal some cheese while Tom is sleeping. Tom wakes up and chases Jerry across a table filled with all kinds of food. During the chase, Tom eats a melon which turns him into a sphere shape and Jerry eats a piece of cheese which turns him into a triangle shape.

programme.title: Batwheels III
programme.desc: You Talkin' To Me? Batman gets help from a mysterious, yet somehow familiar hero as he chases the villain Croc through the tunnels beneath Gotham City.

programme.title: Batwheels
programme.desc: Batwheels, a preschool animated action-adventure comedy series starring the most heroic and iconic vehicles from the DC universe. They are a team of incredible crimefighters who have banded together to oppose evil, combat crime and clean up the streets of Gotham City. They are...okay, they're NOT Batman and Robin. They're the Batwheels - an awesome group of sentient super-powered crime-fighting vehicles defending Gotham City alongside Batman, Robin, Batgirl and a host of DC Super Heroes. Having just been created by the Batcomputer, our heroes are essentially kids with little to no life experience. Led by Bam (The Batmobile), the Batwheels - Bibi (The Batgirl Cycle), Red (The Redbird), Jett (The Batwing) and Buff (The Bat Truck) - must navigate the growing pains of being a newly formed super team as well as the growing pains that come with just being a kid.

programme.title: Meet the Batwheels

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! II
programme.desc: Protein Titans 2. When a video game company tries to buy an old algorithm from Velma and convince her to work for them in San Francisco, the gang becomes embroiled in the mystery of a video game villain who has seemingly come to life, the Ghost Chef.

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! II
programme.desc: World of Witchcraft. The gang goes to Salem, Massachusetts for a historical festival, only to discover history repeating itself as a demon has been set loose on the town, summoned by a witch as revenge for the infamous 17th Century Salem Witch Trials.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings III
programme.desc: In a vast natural reserve lost in the middle of the untamed wilderness, there is a small haven of human civilization: the forest ranger's house. Because he is (from his point of view) the most evolved animal on earth, the bear Grizzy feels it's only natural that the ranger's house becomes his territory as soon as its owner is away. No other animal dares to contest this "bear's privilege" except the most inoffensive, stupid and ridiculous mammal family that exists: the Lemmings - who also move into the house as soon as the ranger is gone. Grizzy and the Lemmings lead a merciless battle over the house in an atmosphere of total madness, where the two adversaries constantly try to outdo each other with nasty tricks!

programme.title: Lamput III
programme.desc: Fashion Show. The premiere event on the fashion calendar is about to begin!! The Docs chase Lamput in through the stage door and bring the tone way down. Before you know it everyone’s embarked upon a short and exceedingly painful catwalk career. This season’s colour: orange. The Docs try their hand at lighting design. They suck at that, too. The blue nerds get ejected hard by venue security, and Lamput becomes the hit look of the show. So versatile! So changeable! One size fits all!

programme.title: Dino Ranch: Island Explorers
programme.desc: Welcome to the Island. The Ranchers are buzzing with excitement -- Ma and Pa are finally visiting Dino Island! Jon, Min, and Miguel go all out preparing a grand welcome party, eager to show their parents just how far they’ve come as Dino Explorers! But Ma and Pa Cassidy find the island overwhelming, until their kids show them the wonder and fun of everything new.

programme.title: Dino Ranch: Island Explorers
programme.desc: The Perfect Present. Ma carefully chisels the perfect gemstone from a cave wall, a sparkling treasure she plans to craft into a beautiful bracelet for Pa, to celebrate their anniversary! There's just one problem: Bo forgot the anniversary! To make it right, Pa enlists the kids' help to find a gift worthy of Ma's sparkle! Their idea? The rare Lava Lily, a flower said to bloom only at the peak of the island's volcano!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series IV
programme.desc: Wicket's Driving Lesson. Fed up of driving Mrs Wicket everywhere, Mr Bean decides to teach her how to drive. He sets up a practice “car” in his flat using tin cans as pedals and household objects for all the levers. Mrs Wicket does so well that Mr Bean lets her have a proper lesson in his beloved car – but Mrs Wicket gets carried away in the real car, and it’s a white-knuckle ride!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series IV
programme.desc: Hiding At Home. Mrs Wicket gives Mr Bean some money for a hotel so that her Uncle Ron can stay in his flat, but Mr Bean decides to keep the money and hide in his wardrobe overnight. He makes himself comfortable among the clothes, but starts to get hungry as he watches Ron eating, and can’t resist sneaking out. Can Mr Bean keep himself hidden all night, especially when he needs the toilet?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series IV
programme.desc: Prize Photo. Mr Bean wants to take a photo of a rare bird, the Rosy Starling, hoping to win a cash prize from a nature magazine. But the special nuts he’s bought to lure the bird have instead attracted a couple of persistent squirrels, who keep hopping onto the bird table he’s installed and helping themselves to the tasty nuts. It’s Bean vs squirrels, or so he thinks…

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series
programme.desc: Homeless. After a regrettable episode involving his landlady sleepwalking into his room, Mr. Bean suddenly finds himself out on his ear with nowhere to live. Near to tears, he yearns for the cosy familiarity of his old home. A scarecrow and a pair of false teeth come to his rescue.

programme.title: Baby Lemmings
programme.desc: High-wire act. The baby lemmings are stunned to witness a collision between two partridges in flight. The impact causes a pile of feathers to fall in front of them, which they use to play at gliding. Baby Owl, meanwhile, is struggling to fly with her tiny wings, and envies the majestic partridges flying in the distance. When she sees the feathers the baby lemmings have collected, she thinks she'll be able to fly better if she takes them!

programme.title: Baby Lemmings
programme.desc: Star on the Run. Baby Beaver has set himself the task of building the tallest tower possible. Unfortunately, it's dark before he can finish, but he's not going to stop, despite the difficulties of building in the dark. As for the Baby Lemmings, they're enjoying the spectacle of shooting stars when suddenly one of them crashes not far from them! A pretty, shiny, luminous stone. They decide to send it back up into the sky with the other stars. But Baby Beaver would love this luminous stone, which would enable him to continue his work even in the dark.

programme.title: Baby Lemmings
programme.desc: Marble Squabble. The Baby chipmunk has a collection of pretty gems. But when she loses a round one and it rolls past the Baby lemmings, they get the idea of organising a marble run. They collect lots of objects, cut them to make them spherical and... And off they go! But when the Baby chipmunk realises she's lost her stone, she wants it back. And when she sees all the new stones the Baby lemmings have collected, she wants them all back! But the baby lemmings have no intention of stopping their mad marble race through the forest!

programme.title: New Looney Tunes
programme.desc: Follow the hilarious, heroic and mischievous Bugs Bunny in a series of slapstick comedic shorts that find the carrot-loving rabbit matching his wits against classic characters such as Theodore "Tasmanian" Devil, Wile E. Coyote and Yosemite Sam. Along the way, Bugs encounters brand-new foes but he has some help from new friends like Bigfoot and Squeaks the Squirrel!

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo!
programme.desc: Game of Chicken. Fred gets a call for help from Chuck Mangum (JOHN VIENER), his daredevil of a best friend, leading the gang on a rescue mission deep in the caverns of an ancient civilization. Once there, they learn of the real mystery: the ghost of the Tribal Warrior that still protects the cavern from outsiders!

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo!
programme.desc: Poodle Justice. It's Scooby's dream come true as the gang visits the set of his favorite TV show and he meets the star, his celebrity crush, a dog actress who plays a detective on the screen. Now all Scooby has to do is work up the courage to actually talk to her while also solving the mystery of the monstrous Gargoyle attacking the production!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series
programme.desc: No Pets. Sometimes Mr. Bean’s Teddy can be no fun at all. Feeling the need for a new friend, Bean buys a parrot. But getting the parrot past his landlady and her one-eyed cat, Scrapper, proves to be no easy task. Next, is trying to get the blasted bird to speak.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series IV
programme.desc: Remote Control Chaos. Mr Bean joins Billy in trying to film his remote-controlled car so they can win an online video competition. But Mrs Wicket interrupts, asking them to set up the garden for Uncle Ron’s birthday party. While she’s off picking him up, they use the furniture to create the ultimate course for their video, but a wonky wheel on the car sends it straight into Ron’s massive birthday cake!

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show III
programme.desc: Catching Some Z's. On the outskirts of Catsylvania, zombie cats pop up out of the ground as Tom passes a cemetery, so Tom runs to Jerry Van Mouseling for help. At first, the mouse thinks Tom is a zombie cat or Frankenstein-cat and tries repelling him. However, once Jerry understands the problem, he and his band of angry peasant mice help fight the zombie cats.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show III
programme.desc: You Are What You Eat. Rick and Ginger wake up late and, in their hurry, they accidentally put dog food in Tom's bowl and cat food in Spike's. This causes Spike to behave like a cat and Tom to act like a dog. Although they're confused at first, they soon eat other types of food and discover how it makes them act.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show III
programme.desc: The iconic cat and mouse rivals are back. The all-new series takes another look at the madcap slapstick and never-ending battle that has made Tom and Jerry two of the most beloved characters of all time.

programme.title: SuperThings: Rivals of Kaboom - Kazoom Power
programme.desc: Kai, Finn, and Mia find themselves thrust into the adventure of their lives when Enigma calls upon them to travel to Kaboom City.

programme.title: Batwheels II
programme.desc: Batwheels, a preschool animated action-adventure comedy series starring the most heroic and iconic vehicles from the DC universe. They are a team of incredible crimefighters who have banded together to oppose evil, combat crime and clean up the streets of Gotham City. They are...okay, they're NOT Batman and Robin. They're the Batwheels - an awesome group of sentient super-powered crime-fighting vehicles defending Gotham City alongside Batman, Robin, Batgirl and a host of DC Super Heroes. Having just been created by the Batcomputer, our heroes are essentially kids with little to no life experience. Led by Bam (The Batmobile), the Batwheels - Bibi (The Batgirl Cycle), Red (The Redbird), Jett (The Batwing) and Buff (The Bat Truck) - must navigate the growing pains of being a newly formed super team as well as the growing pains that come with just being a kid.

programme.title: Bugs Bunny Builders
programme.desc: At ACME Construction Company, Bugs Bunny and Lola Bunny manage a crew of builders that, quite frankly, should not be anywhere near a construction site. However, by working together as a team, Daffy Duck, Porky Pig, Tweety and others use their tools and wild vehicles to pull off some of the looniest construction jobs ever.

programme.title: Bugs Bunny Builders: Hard Hat Time
programme.desc: Bugs Bunny Builders is a fun and exciting preschool series featuring your favorite Looney Tunes working at a construction company. Join Bugs Bunny, Lola Bunny, Daffy Duck, Porky Pig and Tweety Bird as they use their amazing vehicles to take on the looniest builds ever. Along the way, they’ll learn valuable lessons and never give up because The Looney Builders always get the job done!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series
programme.desc: Double Trouble. Mr. Bean is over the moon when he meets Mr. Pod because both men have so much in common; same shirt, jacket, trousers and underpants. And to top it all, Pod is Bean’s spitting image! Bean falls to Earth with a bump, though, when his girlfriend, Irma Gobb, finds Mr. Pod much better looking than him.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series II
programme.desc: Home Movie. Mr Bean is unimpressed with a horror movie he sees at the cinema and reckons he can do much better. Bean sets out to create his very own home movie masterpiece –featuring Mrs Wicket Irma and Teddy! The screening in the garden is a huge success but will Mrs Wicket be pleased with her makeover and starring role?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series IV
programme.desc: Staycation. Mr Bean drops Irma off at the airport – she and Lottie are going on a lovely sunny holiday without them. To cheer Teddy up, Mr Bean has a brainwave - don’t worry, we’ll have a holiday right here at home! So Mr Bean goes about recreating all the things he saw in Irma’s brochure – a flight on an Bean Airways and a stay at Hotel Bean with sea view and a pool! Hope Irma is having a great time too…

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series IV
programme.desc: Funfair. At a funfair, Mr Bean wins a balloon for Teddy and ties it to him while he plays on the hook a duck. But he’s so engrossed he doesn’t notice his companion floating away! Soon Mr Bean is chasing Teddy as he glides and snags on various fairground rides. Will Mr Bean rescue Teddy before he floats away forever?

Because he is (from his point of view) the most evolved animal on earth, the bear Grizzy feels it's only natural that the ranger's house becomes his territory as soon as its owner is away. No other animal dares to contest this "bear's privilege" except the most inoffensive, stupid and ridiculous mammal family that exists: the Lemmings - who also move into the house as soon as the ranger is gone. Grizzy and the Lemmings lead a merciless battle over the house in an atmosphere of total madness, where the two adversaries constantly try to outdo each other with nasty tricks!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series IV
programme.desc: Hiding At Home. Mrs Wicket gives Mr Bean some money for a hotel so that her Uncle Ron can stay in his flat, but Mr Bean decides to keep the money and hide in his wardrobe overnight. He makes himself comfortable among the clothes, but starts to get hungry as he watches Ron eating, and can’t resist sneaking out. Can Mr Bean keep himself hidden all night, especially when he needs the toilet?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series IV
programme.desc: Bean's Bath Bother. Mr Bean needs to clean up after working on his car. However each time he tries to get in the bath, he’s interrupted by plumbers who are doing work in Mrs Wicket’s bathroom. When they turn off the hot water and head off to lunch, leaving Mrs Wicket’s new bath on the front lawn, Mr Bean decides enough is enough. He fills the outdoor bath up and has a soak right there in view of everyone!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series IV
programme.desc: Opera For One. Irma calls Mr Bean to remind him about the Opera they are attending that night, but of course he has forgotten to buy tickets! He rushes to the box office, but they are sold out. So he hatches a plan to intercept the singer, Signor Parmigiano, at the train station and trick him into playing in his back garden – a private performance for just him and Irma!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series IV
programme.desc: Bean Hatches A Plan. Jealous of Mr Paliwal’s new egg-laying chicken, Mr Bean heads off to the local farm to get himself one. But after causing havoc at the coop, he comes home with the wrong chicken – not only will it not lay eggs, but it turns out Mrs Wicket is allergic to feathers so Mr Bean has to keep the chicken well hidden!

programme.title: Lamput III
programme.desc: Skinny At The Pool. When Lamput masquerades as a swimming trophy at the local pool, Skinny finds himself in his red trunks, warming up for the big race. You’d be surprised at how fast a Doc can swim when there’s a Lamput up for grabs. Skinny discovers skills not even he was aware of. Shame the trophies keep switching places. No lap-time in the world can outsmart this little orange blob.

programme.title: Moley
programme.desc: Moley is a lively animated comedy series for children and families of all ages. It follows the underground adventures of a charmingly optimistic young mole, Moley. As the keeper of The Mystical Manual of Magic — known more affectionately as “Manny,” Moley is forever embarking on comedic, zany, Moletastic and thrilling magical adventures which are filled with heart, to help the citizens of the bustling city of MoleTown. What Moley lacks in physical prowess and smarts, he makes up for in heart and friendship! So, with his friends Dotty, a plucky, adventure-seeking mole, Mishmosh, an oddball inventor mole, Mona Lisa, the sensible grounded Mole and Mystic Mole, a wise old mole who knows more than he lets on - there’s no challenge Moley can’t mishandle-- but then soon overcome!

programme.title: Tom and Jerry
programme.desc: Colourful Chase. Jerry fancies himself an artist, but Tom disagrees. Their artistic antics blur lines between art and chaos. Other than a trail of mess, what else will they leave behind?

programme.title: Mush-Mush And The Mushables
programme.desc: Mush-Mush and the Mushables follows the comedy adventures of the Mushable community as together they put the fun back into fungi! As pocket-sized Guardians of the Forest, each Mushable has a special gift; while Mush-Mush can communicate with nature, Lilit shines bright like the light and Chep has an impressive memory. As they get to know thier talents and their limits, the Mushables find there is still a lot to discover about growing up! A fun journey of self-discovery, exciting outdoor adventure and mush mush more!

programme.title: SuperThings: Rivals of Kaboom - Kazoom Power
programme.desc: Ron-Ron at the Race. Velocitix loses Ron-Ron and must get him back before Mr. King finds out, but Jelly Beam won't make it easy for him.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show II
programme.desc: Going Going Gone Viral. When Rick uploads a video of Tom getting his head stuck in Jerry's mouse hole, the video instantly goes viral and Tom becomes the laughing stock of the feline community. Now Tom must restore his reputation by catching Jerry and capturing it all on video. Easier said than done.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show II
programme.desc: The Tortoise Don't Play Fair. When a Hare loses to a Tortoise in the biggest race of the year, he comes to Tom and Jerry claiming foul play. It's up to the duo to see what's really behind the most famous race in history.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show II
programme.desc: Fish Out of Water. Hildie and Beatie return from the Ol' Time Goblin Fair with kettle corn, a giant stuffed warlock, and a piranha they won in the ball toss. Despite their warning not to touch the fish, Tom can't pass up a chance to eat the catch of the day! But first he has to get past Jerry who is determined to protect his new friend. When a failed attempt by Tom ends up with the fish bowl being shattered, Jerry quickly casts a spell with the wand that allows the fish to breathe on dry land! The liberated fish is excited to explore his newfound freedom (walking on his tail fin) and ends up making life a lot more complicated for Jerry who's trying to protect him!

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show II
programme.desc: Cat Match Fever. Butch is bobbing for apple cores when he spots a dolled up Toodles heading his way! Butch slicks back his hair with some lard and strikes a pose. But she walks right past the alley cat. Meanwhile, inside the house, Tom spots Toodles headed in his direction. After a quick spruce up, Tom opens the door only to watch her walk right past the house. Tom slumps. Turns out Toodles is headed to Winston's house. Yep, who knew the two were a match made in kitty heaven (or at least that's what the catmatch app said). Tom and Butch both set out to win Toodles affection while Jerry plays Cyrano to Winston to help him get over his nerves.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show II
programme.desc: Cold Snap. Wanting to cool off from the blistering heat, Tom and Jerry use a little magic to make it snow, turning the witches' world into a haunted winter wonderland with an evil snowman, haunted snow forts and magic snowball fights. Now they have to figure out how to make it stop snowing.

programme.title: Dino Ranch: Island Explorers
programme.desc: Welcome to the Island. The Ranchers are buzzing with excitement -- Ma and Pa are finally visiting Dino Island! Jon, Min, and Miguel go all out preparing a grand welcome party, eager to show their parents just how far they’ve come as Dino Explorers! But Ma and Pa Cassidy find the island overwhelming, until their kids show them the wonder and fun of everything new.

programme.title: Dino Ranch: Island Explorers
programme.desc: The Perfect Present. Ma carefully chisels the perfect gemstone from a cave wall, a sparkling treasure she plans to craft into a beautiful bracelet for Pa, to celebrate their anniversary! There's just one problem: Bo forgot the anniversary! To make it right, Pa enlists the kids' help to find a gift worthy of Ma's sparkle! Their idea? The rare Lava Lily, a flower said to bloom only at the peak of the island's volcano!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series IV
programme.desc: Train Trouble. Mr Bean is off on a train trip but loses his ticket as he waves goodbye to Irma on the platform, so has to find ways of escaping the eagle-eyed ticket inspector. He hides in the toilet, crawls under seats and even climbs into the luggage rack! But can he avoid her until he reaches his destination?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series IV
programme.desc: Blown Away. Mr Bean has cleared up the leaves in Mrs Wicket’s path using a leafblower, but can’t find anywhere to put the heap he’s created. So he uses the power tool to blow the pile of leaves in a neat bundle along the street to find somewhere to dump them. Things take a turn when he inadvertently manages to foil a bank robbery with his new toy.

programme.title: Baby Lemmings
programme.desc: High-wire act. The baby lemmings are stunned to witness a collision between two partridges in flight. The impact causes a pile of feathers to fall in front of them, which they use to play at gliding. Baby Owl, meanwhile, is struggling to fly with her tiny wings, and envies the majestic partridges flying in the distance. When she sees the feathers the baby lemmings have collected, she thinks she'll be able to fly better if she takes them!

programme.title: Baby Lemmings
programme.desc: Star on the Run. Baby Beaver has set himself the task of building the tallest tower possible. Unfortunately, it's dark before he can finish, but he's not going to stop, despite the difficulties of building in the dark. As for the Baby Lemmings, they're enjoying the spectacle of shooting stars when suddenly one of them crashes not far from them! A pretty, shiny, luminous stone. They decide to send it back up into the sky with the other stars. But Baby Beaver would love this luminous stone, which would enable him to continue his work even in the dark.

programme.title: Baby Lemmings
programme.desc: Square Leaf. Baby Raccoon notices that the forest floor is covered in leaves... No way! It's too dirty for him. He decides to rake them up into nice, cubic heaps, not realizing that he's providing great cushions for the baby lemmings, who have fun throwing themselves into them making firework displays of colorful leaves! Faced with this rampage, Baby Raccoon decides to block the baby lemmings and resume his housework, but the little baby lemmings have more than one trick up their sleeve!

programme.title: Batwheels III
programme.desc: Third Wheel. Buff feels left out at a playdate with Snowy and Grundy, and he goes off on his own. But when Banebuggy shows up, Buff needs his friends more than ever!

programme.title: Batwheels II
programme.desc: Batwheels, a preschool animated action-adventure comedy series starring the most heroic and iconic vehicles from the DC universe. They are a team of incredible crimefighters who have banded together to oppose evil, combat crime and clean up the streets of Gotham City. They are...okay, they're NOT Batman and Robin. They're the Batwheels - an awesome group of sentient super-powered crime-fighting vehicles defending Gotham City alongside Batman, Robin, Batgirl and a host of DC Super Heroes. Having just been created by the Batcomputer, our heroes are essentially kids with little to no life experience. Led by Bam (The Batmobile), the Batwheels - Bibi (The Batgirl Cycle), Red (The Redbird), Jett (The Batwing) and Buff (The Bat Truck) - must navigate the growing pains of being a newly formed super team as well as the growing pains that come with just being a kid.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series II
programme.desc: The Cruise. Mr Bean wins two tickets for an exotic cruise and naturally he takes Teddy along for the trip of a lifetime. Once aboard the huge ocean liner Mr Bean soon settles into a life of luxury but while showing off to a new friend Bean becomes ‘man overboard’ and stranded on a dessert island. The hungrier he gets the wilder he becomes and desperate to find a way off the island.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series II
programme.desc: Coconut Shy. Mr Bean goes to his favourite china shop to buy a new cup for Teddy but when he opens his wallet he doesn’t have enough money to pay for it. When he sees a poster for the local funfair where the stalls have cash prizes Bean is determined to win himself some money on the Coconut Shy. But after many unsuccessful attempts he realises it’s a fix and lets everyone know about it. Naturally this doesn’t go down well with the stallholder who wants revenge and a chase around the funfair ensues.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series IV
programme.desc: Trampoline Trouble. Mr Bean is bored of queuing for a trampoline park, so secretly bounces in through a window using a trampette. But he soon gets on the wrong side of a young show-off boy who keeps stealing Teddy and throwing him in hard-to-reach spots. To settle their row, they agree on a race around the trampoline park – first place wins Teddy. Will Mr Bean triumph before he’s chucked out for jumping the queue?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series
programme.desc: Keyboard Capers. Determined to master Beethoven’s symphony, Mr Bean wangles himself a grand piano, a music book, a candelabra and a very patient piano teacher. Liberace, eat your heart out!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series IV
programme.desc: Sheepish Bean. Irma is struggling to sell items from her knitwear stall at the market, so sends Mr Bean to collect a sheep costume he can wear to attract customers. Once at the fancy dress shop however, Mr Bean gets stuck in the sheep costume and has to travel back to the market wearing it. Things go from bad to worse when Mr Bean takes a short cut across the field and gets caught up in a flock of real sheep!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series IV
programme.desc: Page Turner. Mr Bean spots a rare book - the Teddy Bear Haunting - in a bookshop, but it’s too expensive to buy. He secretly tries to read it in the shop… until he’s thrown out. To his dismay someone else then buys the book – so he follows the buyer around trying to read over his shoulder. Will Mr Bean manage to get to the end of the book before getting spotted?

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! II
programme.desc: How to Train Your Coward. Finally fed up with monsters and mayhem, Shaggy and Scooby decide to quit the gang and train their replacements in one on-the-job training session, unraveling the mystery of a vampire that's terrorizing a small town.

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! II
programme.desc: Worst in Show. After a Giant Houndbeast attacks an elite dog show, the gang goes undercover and enters Scooby in the show in order to solve the mystery.

Because he is (from his point of view) the most evolved animal on earth, the bear Grizzy feels it's only natural that the ranger's house becomes his territory as soon as its owner is away. No other animal dares to contest this "bear's privilege" except the most inoffensive, stupid and ridiculous mammal family that exists: the Lemmings - who also move into the house as soon as the ranger is gone. Grizzy and the Lemmings lead a merciless battle over the house in an atmosphere of total madness, where the two adversaries constantly try to outdo each other with nasty tricks!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series III
programme.desc: Mr Bean returns for a third series of his animated adventures. Featuring in 26 brand new episodes. This series follows Mr Bean, his best friend Teddy and his long-suffering landlady Mrs Wicket as we witness more of the mishaps that surround Mr Bean's daily life. Mr Bean becomes obsessed with computer gaming, prevents Mrs. Wicket from selling her house, builds his own caravan, rescues a football from a haunted house and finds himself in many other hilarious escapades. All voiced by Rowan Atkinson.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series IV
programme.desc: Walking Into Trouble. Mr Bean is far from thrilled to be going on a country walk with Irma to see an ancient ruin, especially when he sees a pair of ramblers with all the latest hiking kit. But instead of taking up their offer of help, he gets extremely competitive and is desperate to beat them to the stone circle, even when Irma gets fed up and joins her new hiking friends.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series
programme.desc: Sofa. Mr. Bean likes nothing more than to relax on his sofa with a good meal and his favourite telly programme. Unfortunately, a painful explosion of springs under his bottom puts an end to that. He sets about buying another one… but, alas, sofas are expensive items. TV dinners may well be a thing of the past for Mr Bean.

programme.title: Tom and Jerry Gokko
programme.desc: Rainbow Candy Shop. Tom is taking selfies and enjoying a sweet snack at the candy shop, when Jerry and Tuffy sneak up and eat his strawberries. Tom proceeds to chase after them, but Tuffy falls into the claw machine. Jerry tries to save him, and Tom fishes them out. Tom makes Tuffy cry and apologizes by feeding him sweets.

programme.title: Batwheels III
programme.desc: They're the Batwheels - an awesome group of sentient super-powered crime-fighting vehicles defending Gotham City alongside a host of DC Super Heroes.

programme.title: Batwheels
programme.desc: Batwheels, a preschool animated action-adventure comedy series starring the most heroic and iconic vehicles from the DC universe. They are a team of incredible crimefighters who have banded together to oppose evil, combat crime and clean up the streets of Gotham City. They are...okay, they're NOT Batman and Robin. They're the Batwheels - an awesome group of sentient super-powered crime-fighting vehicles defending Gotham City alongside Batman, Robin, Batgirl and a host of DC Super Heroes. Having just been created by the Batcomputer, our heroes are essentially kids with little to no life experience. Led by Bam (The Batmobile), the Batwheels - Bibi (The Batgirl Cycle), Red (The Redbird), Jett (The Batwing) and Buff (The Bat Truck) - must navigate the growing pains of being a newly formed super team as well as the growing pains that come with just being a kid.

programme.desc: Professor Huh? Part 1. Fred and the gang are called in to help with a mystery involving a figure from Fred's past, Professor Huh? Fred discovers Rose, with whom he learned mystery solving until they had a falling out, has also arrived with her gang.

programme.title: Lamput III
programme.desc: Opera. Specs and Skinny spruce themselves up and head out to a piano concerto in the royal concert hall. They're on their best behavior, until they spot a fellow culture vulture who also happens to be small, orange and squishy. Honestly, they're letting all sorts of rabble into these places these days. The Docs decide that a sleeping potion might be a quick and quiet way of capturing Lamput. Naturally things get out of hand, and when the entire audience catches a whiff of the snoozy brew, we find out exactly how hard it is to stay awake during a classical music recital. One star.

programme.title: Dino Ranch: Island Explorers
programme.desc: The Best Brother. Deep in the jungle, chaos erupts when a pair of raptors ambush the kids. But before the predators can strike, Uncle Jack and Pa swoop in, tackling the dinos with daring moves and perfect timing! As the brothers trade grins and playful jabs, it’s clear this isn’t just teamwork, it’s a competition! This kickstarts the ultimate race, as the brothers compete to get to the top of the volcano first.

programme.title: Dino Ranch: Island Explorers
programme.desc: The Perfect Last Day. It’s Ma and Pa’s last day on Dino Island, and the Ranchers are determined to make it perfect! So, they each pick one big adventure—three epic Cassidy-style activities to send their parents off in unforgettable fashion! However, each activity ends in ultimate failure and the kids are disappointed- until they are reminded by their parents that any day spent together is the perfect day.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series IV
programme.desc: Scrapper's Snack. Mr Bean buys himself a DIY remote-controlled boat kit so he can compete in a race on the local pond. But just as he’s about to finish it, Scrapper sniffs out some nearby sandwiches and causes havoc. In the confusion, Mr Bean thinks the cat has swallowed the rudder of his toy boat, so has to capture him and take him to the vet. Will he get his rudder back in time for the race?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series IV
programme.desc: Bean's Bath Bother. Mr Bean needs to clean up after working on his car. However each time he tries to get in the bath, he’s interrupted by plumbers who are doing work in Mrs Wicket’s bathroom. When they turn off the hot water and head off to lunch, leaving Mrs Wicket’s new bath on the front lawn, Mr Bean decides enough is enough. He fills the outdoor bath up and has a soak right there in view of everyone!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series IV
programme.desc: Movie Mayhem. Irma and Mr Bean are at the cinema to see the three hour long “Romance In Paris”, which Mr Bean is not looking forward to. But when he sees that they are also showing an action movie – Zombie Aliens 3 – he finds a way to sneak out and into the other screen. But will he get past the usher, and what will happen when Irma notices?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series
programme.desc: Camping. An old photo album causes Bean to reminisce about his lovely summers at scout camp as a boy, and sets him planning a night under the stars with Teddy. Purchasing a tent becomes a tricky problem – but nothing will stop him having a good time, even if he has to get the garden shed over the roof of his house.

programme.title: Baby Lemmings
programme.desc: Miniature adventures. With Baby Owl bored to tears, the Baby Lemmings have invented a new game: figurines made from acorns. With them, they create a kind of small village in their own playmobile style. Baby Owl would like to play with them, but clumsily destroys the whole village. Thinking she's done it on purpose, the Baby Lemmings run away from her in the hope of being able to play in peace.

programme.title: Baby Lemmings
programme.desc: Crickets of a feather. The Baby Lemmings become friends and play with crickets. Baby Moose hates these bugs, which terrify him. Baby Moose hides to avoid running into the insects, but he comes face to face with a cricket that has been thrown off while playing with the lemmings. Panic-stricken, Baby Moose tries to put these threatening pests out of action, but after a blunder he finds himself adrift on the water with a cricket!

programme.title: Baby Lemmings
programme.desc: Foolhardy Plushie. Baby Owl can't sleep without her little owl blankie. But she loses it because she's clumsy. When the baby lemmings discover it, they think it's so cool they decide to include it in their activities - it really is a good friend! In a panic, Baby Owl looks for her comforter and tries to get it back from the baby lemmings, but her clumsiness gives them the impression that she wants to harm the comforter! The baby lemmings decide to protect the comforter against all odds!

programme.title: New Looney Tunes
programme.desc: Follow the hilarious, heroic and mischievous Bugs Bunny in a series of slapstick comedic shorts that find the carrot-loving rabbit matching his wits against classic characters such as Theodore "Tasmanian" Devil, Wile E. Coyote and Yosemite Sam. Along the way, Bugs encounters brand-new foes but he has some help from new friends like Bigfoot and Squeaks the Squirrel!

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo!
programme.desc: Be Quiet Scooby-Doo! To solve the mystery of a creepy Crystal Crawler - a bat-like cave monster - the Gang must venture into the Crystal Canopy - a labyrinth of intricate crystal formations. To make things worse, they can't speak a word while in the Canopy, because even the slightest sound will bring the crystals crashing down around them!

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo!
programme.desc: All Paws on Deck. Despite Velma's strong dislike of water, the Gang climb aboard the cruise ship run by Fred's cousin. But a water phobia is the least of their problems when a terrifying Sea Monster attacks the ship!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series
programme.desc: Ray of Sunshine. It’s a beautiful day at the beach. Bean breathes in the salty air, bliss - and not another soul in sight. What could possibly spoil his perfect day? Answer: British weather. Mr. Bean finds himself chasing an illusive ray of sunshine across town, over hills and dales, a football stadium and the English Channel.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series IV
programme.desc: Scrapper's Feeding Time. Mrs Wicket is off for the weekend, and insists Mr Bean feed her cat Scrapper at 5am and 5pm every day. The evenings are OK, but Mr Bean can’t face getting up at dawn every day just for a cat! So he plugs his old train set into a timer, set to deliver Scrapper’s food at the required times. But by unplugging Mrs Wicket’s timers, her lamps don’t activate and some burglars spot an opportunity…

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show III
programme.desc: Not My Tyke. Spike orders Tom and Jerry to watch Tyke while he's away, but instead Tom takes the opportunity to chase Jerry in the backyard. Suddenly, Tyke is nowhere to be seen and the front gate is wide open! Tom and Jerry must find the pup in time or face Spike's beating.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show III
programme.desc: A Head For Science. On the edge of the village of Catsylvania, Tom is carried off to Dr. Frankenstein's castle lab. Several lightning bolts later, a monster comes to life: a nine-foot-tall hulk with Tom's relatively tiny head sewn on. Frankenstein orders the monster to go terrorize the village, but it has problems focusing after Tom's head sees Jerry in the lab.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show III
programme.desc: Everyone Into the Pool. When Tom and Jerry go to a pool party at Toodles's place, Tom shows off in the pool with ridiculous stunts. Butch and Meathead arrive, adding more rivalry to the party. Soon, Toodles suggests they play a game of water polo, which reaches a fever pitch before long.

programme.title: SuperThings: Rivals of Kaboom - Kazoom Power
programme.desc: Wreck Delivery Service. The villains have discovered the location of Enigma’s base and the Kazoom Kids must protect it from an attack led by Mr. King.

programme.desc: At ACME Construction Company, Bugs Bunny and Lola Bunny manage a crew of builders that, quite frankly, should not be anywhere near a construction site. However, by working together as a team, Daffy Duck, Porky Pig, Tweety and others use their tools and wild vehicles to pull off some of the looniest construction jobs ever.

programme.title: Bugs Bunny Builders: Hard Hat Time
programme.desc: Bugs Bunny Builders is a fun and exciting preschool series featuring your favorite Looney Tunes working at a construction company. Join Bugs Bunny, Lola Bunny, Daffy Duck, Porky Pig and Tweety Bird as they use their amazing vehicles to take on the looniest builds ever. Along the way, they’ll learn valuable lessons and never give up because The Looney Builders always get the job done!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series II
programme.desc: Fish Sitting. Mr Bean has to look after Mrs Wicket’s pet goldfish while she is away. With a ravenous Scrapper sniffing around Bean ends up becoming more bodyguard than babysitter. But when he manages to lose his fishy friend Mr Bean takes a nightmare journey down the sewer and back to his neighbour’s house via the park. Can Mr Bean get the pesky pet back in the bowl before Mrs Wicket returns home?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series II
programme.desc: The Cruise. Mr Bean wins two tickets for an exotic cruise and naturally he takes Teddy along for the trip of a lifetime. Once aboard the huge ocean liner Mr Bean soon settles into a life of luxury but while showing off to a new friend Bean becomes ‘man overboard’ and stranded on a dessert island. The hungrier he gets the wilder he becomes and desperate to find a way off the island.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series IV
programme.desc: Grandfather Clock. Mrs Wicket has just inherited an antique grandfather clock – Mr Bean is impressed! But he soon starts to resent it when it bongs loudly on the hour all through the night. Desperate for sleep as dawn is breaking, he fiddles inside the clock, only for it to fall apart and onto the floor! Can he get the bulky heirloom to a repair shop and back before Mrs Wicket wakes up?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series IV
programme.desc: The New Dress. In the run-up to a fundraising event for the Donkey Sanctuary, Irma realises she doesn’t have a posh dress, so Mr Bean goes to buy one for her. However, all the dresses are very expensive – but he comes up with a plan. He can buy a dress, then return it after the event provided it still has the label attached. Can Mr Bean protect the dress without Irma realising what he’s doing?

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings III
programme.desc: In a vast natural reserve lost in the middle of the untamed wilderness, there is a small haven of human civilization: the forest ranger's house. Because he is (from his point of view) the most evolved animal on earth, the bear Grizzy feels it's only natural that the ranger's house becomes his territory as soon as its owner is away. No other animal dares to contest this "bear's privilege" except the most inoffensive, stupid and ridiculous mammal family that exists: the Lemmings - who also move into the house as soon as the ranger is gone. Grizzy and the Lemmings lead a merciless battle over the house in an atmosphere of total madness, where the two adversaries constantly try to outdo each other with nasty tricks!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series IV
programme.desc: Remote Control Chaos. Mr Bean joins Billy in trying to film his remote-controlled car so they can win an online video competition. But Mrs Wicket interrupts, asking them to set up the garden for Uncle Ron’s birthday party. While she’s off picking him up, they use the furniture to create the ultimate course for their video, but a wonky wheel on the car sends it straight into Ron’s massive birthday cake!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series IV
programme.desc: Scrapper's Feeding Time. Mrs Wicket is off for the weekend, and insists Mr Bean feed her cat Scrapper at 5am and 5pm every day. The evenings are OK, but Mr Bean can’t face getting up at dawn every day just for a cat! So he plugs his old train set into a timer, set to deliver Scrapper’s food at the required times. But by unplugging Mrs Wicket’s timers, her lamps don’t activate and some burglars spot an opportunity…

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series IV
programme.desc: Pretend Patient. Mr Bean is settling in for his favourite TV show marathon when Irma rings to remind him they’re having lunch at her mum’s. He pretends to be ill, which backfires when Irma comes over to look after him – but soon he’s taking advantage of Irma who is waiting on him hand and foot. It’s all going great until Irma’s mum turns up and starts to take charge; no TV, no popcorn and worst of all – no Teddy!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series IV
programme.desc: Window Of Opportunity. Mr Paliwal is organising the neighbours for a street clean so they can win “Britain’s Tidiest Street”. But when the window cleaner cancels, Mr Bean sees a money-making opportunity and offers to help. He invents his own mobile window-cleaning device which works brilliantly! But rushing around with a long cleaning pole and a wheelie bin full of water might not have been the best idea when everyone’s rushing around.

programme.title: Tom and Jerry Gokko
programme.desc: Midnight Music Mayhem. It’s the middle of the night and Tom plays makeshift instruments creating loud music that wakes up Jerry. Jerry tries to put an end to Tom's concert with no success. Tuffy wakes up and goes along with the music. Jerry decides to join in on the fun.

programme.title: Moley
programme.desc: Moley is a lively animated comedy series for children and families of all ages. It follows the underground adventures of a charmingly optimistic young mole, Moley. As the keeper of The Mystical Manual of Magic — known more affectionately as “Manny,” Moley is forever embarking on comedic, zany, Moletastic and thrilling magical adventures which are filled with heart, to help the citizens of the bustling city of MoleTown. What Moley lacks in physical prowess and smarts, he makes up for in heart and friendship! So, with his friends Dotty, a plucky, adventure-seeking mole, Mishmosh, an oddball inventor mole, Mona Lisa, the sensible grounded Mole and Mystic Mole, a wise old mole who knows more than he lets on - there’s no challenge Moley can’t mishandle-- but then soon overcome!
